deployments_detail.use: Bhargavastra counter-drone (C-UAS) micro-missile system with AI/ML-based target recognition and C4I command-and-control that detects, classifies and decides whether to engage single drones or swarms; radar/EO-IR/RF sensor fusion, target-to-interception under 16 seconds. Developed by subsidiary Economic Explosives Ltd / Solar Defence and Aerospace; successfully test-fired Jan 2025 and May 2025, now in final trials ahead of army induction. [In-house (Economic Explosives Ltd / Solar Defence and Aerospace)]
deployments_detail.value: detects small drones at 6 km, engages at 2.5 km, up to 64 micro-missiles in salvo

deployments_detail.use: Nagastra-1 loitering munition (kamikaze UAV) with AI-backed target tracking and GPS-enabled precision strike (2 m accuracy), day/night surveillance camera. 480 units delivered to and accepted by the Indian Army for precision-strike operations. [In-house (Solar Defence / Economic Explosives Ltd)]
deployments_detail.value: 480 units delivered; 2 m strike accuracy; >75% indigenous content

deployments_detail.use: Vijayastra MALE UAV / counter-drone platform with an AI-powered system that detects, classifies and tracks hostile drones within seconds, operating in GPS-denied and electronic-warfare environments; AI-enabled swarm capability. Showcased/prototype demonstration by Solar Industries. [In-house (Solar Defence and Aerospace)]

AI-powered Industry 5.0 robotics & UAV manufacturing ecosystem at MIHAN SEZ, Nagpur (via Solar Defence and Aerospace): AI-driven manufacturing, intelligent automation and autonomous systems to produce ~10,000 drones and ~1,000 robots annually. Bhoomi Pujan / groundbreaking held March 2026; facility under construction over 3-4 years. [In-house (Solar Defence and Aerospace)]
deployments_detail.value: Rs 12,800 crore (~$1.3B) investment; 10,000 drones + 1,000 robots/year; ~249 acres

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous AI-enabled robots designed to guard/man Indian borders in extreme conditions (temperatures as low as -40C, e.g. Siachen Glacier), to be manufactured at the new Nagpur robotics facility — autonomous systems intended to assist or replace human soldiers in extreme environments. [In-house (Solar Defence and Aerospace)]

Nagastra-3 (and layered Nagastra-2/Vijayastra) long-range loitering munitions under development, designed for long-range precision, high endurance and autonomous strikes; described as pairing with modern AI for autonomous deep-strike capabilities up to ~100 km (with stated ambitions toward 700 km). [In-house (Solar Defence and Aerospace)]
deployments_detail.value: ~100 km projected range; 700 km deep-strike ambition
